findings.finding: 5 A VBUS/PVDD path routed in 0.255 mm F.Cu tracks and 1-3 x 0.3 mm vias per layer change: J1 VBUS pads to R1/D1 via 0.255 mm tracks only; R1 pad1 one via; Q1 source 3 vias, drain 2 vias; TPA3221 PVDD groups 3 vias each
findings.evidence: Parsed core.kicad_pcb: VBUS_IN tracks 0.25-0.3 mm, 3 vias; VBUS 15 vias (3 at R1, 3 at Q1); PVDD Q1 drain vias (54.16,170.25),(58.44,170.25); IPC-2152 10 mil 1 oz ext ~1 A @10 C; 2.5 A/trace, 1.7-2.5 A/via at 5 A

findings.finding: Firmware turn-on of PVDD exceeds AO4485 single-pulse SOA: 940 uF charged in ~12 ms
findings.evidence: sim tb_core_fw_on_28v: 2.16 A, 46.7 W peak, 0.364 J, 10-90 % 10 ms; AOS AO4485 Rev1.1 fig 10: ~20 W at 10 ms (~0.2 J)

findings.finding: Miller cap C2 (gate-drain) turns Q1 on at every VBUS rising edge with firmware off: PVDD follows VBUS minus Vth during attach and the 5->20 V PD step; inrush up to 20.6 A at the PD max slew; Q4/PG AND does not help
findings.evidence: sims tb_lite_pd_step_fw_off_sr30/3/0.5: 20.6/2.0/0.30 A source, PVDD 15.6/14.8/10.5 V; attach 6.1 A, PVDD 2.8 V

findings.finding: Firmware turn-on of PVDD at the AO4485 SOA edge and 2.5 A inrush on a 3 A contract
findings.evidence: sim tb_lite_fw_on_20v: 2.40 A FET, 2.49 A source, 43 W peak, 0.134 J in ~5 ms vs ~25 W at 5 ms (0.12-0.15 J)

findings.finding: TCA9555 internal ~100k pull-ups vs 100k pull-downs: enables float at 1.1-1.65 V from power-up until firmware writes the expander; low-Vth 2N7002 turns PVDD on
findings.evidence: TI SCPS200E sec 5 (TCA9555 = TCA9535 + internal pull-up), IIL -100 uA max -> Rpu >= 55k; PVDD_ENG = 3.3*50/(Rpu+50) = 1.1-1.57 V; JSCJ 2N7002 Vth 1.0-2.5 V; Q1 needs 0.14 mA

findings.finding: No hardware link between PD contract and PVDD: through hard reset / renegotiation / replug Q1 stays on (held by TCA9555), the source then charges 940 uF at its own slew on the 5->28 V step -> OCP / hard-reset loop; no VBUS ADC sense on core; CH224Q PG unconnected
findings.evidence: topology; slew analysis as POWER-3 (940 uF x 30 V/ms = 28 A)
